description: Director-KB triple schema. Externalized config so adding a new relation or entity type or atom tag is a config edit, not a code change. Principle 4 of the no-lock-in architecture.
_principles_anchor: See docs/director_kb_arch.md for the 12 no-lock-in principles this schema preserves.

memory.comment: USER memory directory lives OUTSIDE the repo; ingest reads, never writes, this directory.

cert_ledger.comment: Each line = ledger row. Yields (atom_id, VERDICT_OF, <verdict>) + (atom_id, CERT_CLASS, <class>) + etc per row.

atoms.cap_rationale: Cap bumped 5000 -> 200000 on 2026-07-03 (testbed). Root cause: 5000-line head-order cap silently skipped today's math atoms (target atom at math/atoms.jsonl line 28987 of 28993) making them unqueryable via director_kb_query.py. USER project principle substrate_ingest_completeness_and_addressability: KB must be complete. Original 5000 was perf-motivated on math/concept atoms but concept has 142219 lines and math 28993 lines; head-cap made recent atoms permanently invisible. 200000 accommodates current concept (142K) with ~40% headroom for growth. Ingest-time bound now enforced by hard_cap in code (bumped 50000 -> 2000000; per-file triples).
atoms.comment: Each line = one atom. Entity = atom id; relations from atom fields. Per-file line cap 200000 (see cap_rationale).

concept_relations.comment: ConceptNet-derived word-relation edge list. Each line = {src_id, tgt_id, rel_type}; emits (src_id, <rel_type>, tgt_id) as a genuine directed graph edge (relation TYPE becomes the predicate). 189654 edges / 141511 word nodes / 33 rel_types (CN_SYNONYM, IS_A, HYPERNYM, PART_OF, ...). Densifies the concept/word subgraph (was only 2 CN_* nodes present) to unblock the teacher-free encoder path. Added 2026-07-08 testbed.

director_plan.comment: Single file; current strategic state. Carries body via standard text extractors.

wordnet.comment: Princeton WordNet 3.1 via NLTK. Entities: SYNSET, WORD_SENSE, LEMMA. Relations: HYPERNYM_OF, HYPONYM_OF, MEMBER_HOLONYM_OF, PART_HOLONYM_OF, SIMILAR_TO, ANTONYM_OF, GLOSS, EXAMPLE, POS_TAG, LEMMA_OF. ~117k synsets at full ingest; api_max_items caps sample sizes for smoke.

verbnet.comment: Levin-class predicate-argument templates via NLTK. Entities: VERB_CLASS, MEMBER_VERB, THEMATIC_ROLE, SELECTIONAL_RESTRICTION. Relations: CLASS_OF, ROLE_OF, RESTRICTS_TO, FRAME_OF_CLASS, SYNTAX_PATTERN. ~429 classes.

framenet.comment: Berkeley FrameNet via NLTK. Entities: FRAME, FRAME_ELEMENT, LEXICAL_UNIT. Relations: HAS_FE, EVOKED_BY, INHERITS_FROM, USES_FRAME, PRECEDES_FRAME, FRAME_OF. ~1221 frames.

gene_ontology.comment: Gene Ontology .obo file fetched to data/bio_kb_cache/go/go-basic.obo from https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/go-basic.obo. Parser yields per-term: (term_id, IS_A_NAMESPACE, <namespace>), (term_id, NAMED, <name>), (name, ALIAS_OF, term_id), and IS_A + PART_OF + REGULATES + POSITIVELY_REGULATES + NEGATIVELY_REGULATES + OCCURS_IN triples. Skips obsolete terms. USER 2026-06-26 bio_trio.

kegg_pathway.comment: KEGG pathway KGML XML fetched via REST (rest.kegg.jp). Default focus: hsa04* signaling + neural pathways. Parser yields PATHWAY/REACTION/COMPOUND/ENZYME/GENE entities + STEP_OF/CATALYZES/REACTANT_OF/PRODUCT_OF/REGULATES_PATHWAY relations. Throttle: 1.0s between fetches at fetch time (not ingest time). USER 2026-06-26 bio_trio.

neurolex.comment: NeuroLex / NIF-Ontology TTL subset (SciCrunch GitHub raw) + curated fallback TSV. Files: NIF-Cell.ttl, NIF-Neuron-NT-Bridge.ttl, NIF-GrossAnatomy.ttl, NIF-Molecule.ttl, _curated_fallback.tsv. Conservative TTL parsing (single-line triple statements + rdfs:label + subClassOf only). Curated fallback ensures basic brain-region / cell-type / neurotransmitter queries work even if SciCrunch URLs unavailable. USER 2026-06-26 bio_trio.

capability_registry.comment: Machine-computed WIRE/SHELVE capability-tracking registry (USER 2026-07-28, durable capability-tracking system). One line = one capability decision row, maintained by tools/capability_registry_audit.py. Answers 'what's WIRED / what's islanded / what serves need X' by query instead of grep. Distinct from the 'atoms' source class (test-run-level substrate_capability_registry.jsonl scanned separately, not yet a director_kb source).

proofwiki.comment: ProofWiki Featured pages (~500 in smoke; ~35k full) materialized as .md with YAML front-matter (license, source_url, entity_type, mathematical_field). Picked up by chain-grade chunk-ingest pipeline via glob. Provenance + attribution required per CC-BY-SA-3.0. USER 2026-06-27 math/science extractor design rank-1; strategic prerequisite for vision Phase 3 (substrate proposes new mathematics).

_relation_types_note: IS_CHUNK_OF / SECTION_HEADER / CHUNK_CONTENT are the chunk-emission relations added by UNIFIED-KB (2026-07-02). They are pre-populated by run_ingest AFTER the schema-declared list even if absent here (see hdlab/director_kb.py::CHUNK_RELATIONS_REQUIRED intern), so ordering stays deterministic across ingests.

limits.max_body_bytes_per_file_history: Bumped 512KB -> 128MB on 2026-07-02 (testbed). Root cause: stage-1 CG_META atoms in data/substrate_index/{math,meta,concept,science,research_history,decision_history}/atoms.jsonl exceed 512KB (math=36MB, concept=52MB, meta=995KB); silently skipped with body_exceeds_max_bytes; USER-critical stage-1 SCALE_FREE + TOPOLOGY_FREE physics-law atoms never ingested into director-KB. 128MB gives 2.5x headroom over largest known file.

reingest_determinism.guarantee: Given identical source files (byte-for-byte) and identical schema version + encoder, two ingests produce identical atom sets (same indices, same tag values, same W matrix mod numerical noise tolerance).
